verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe plugin marketplaces built for distributing plugins, including skills. These marketplaces offer centralized discovery, version tracking, automatic updates and git-repo or local-path sources (docs-8, docs-36, docs-9), and plugins are explicitly meant for sharing with teammates (docs-7, docs-21). Anthropic's own GitHub repo works as an installable marketplace (gh-1, gh-4), project-scoped skills live at `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (docs-33), and API skills can be private to a workspace (docs-12, docs-24). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that committing `.claude/skills` to a repo shares skills with the team (only implied by the path), and independent hands-on corroboration of team-wide distribution.
